ok.label: Active
ok.hint: This license is valid and can be used on activated devices.

notActivated.label: Not Activated
notActivated.hint: This server hasn't activated a license for this product yet, so it can't hand out seats.

expired.label: Expired
expired.hint: This license has passed its expiry date and no longer works until it is renewed.

suspended.label: Suspended
suspended.hint: This license is temporarily paused. It starts working again on its own once the software vendor lifts the suspension.

gracePeriodOver.label: Sync Required
gracePeriodOver.hint: This server couldn't sync with {appName} in time, so it stopped handing out seats until it syncs again.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.hint: This product is turned off in config.yml, so this server does not serve it.

allowedFloatingClients.label: Concurrent Seats
allowedFloatingClients.hint: Devices holding a seat right now, out of the maximum allowed at the same time. A device frees its seat when the app closes or its lease runs out.

expiresAt.label: Expires
expiresAt.hint: After this, devices can't get a seat.

leasingStrategy.label: Leasing Strategy
leasingStrategy.hint: How seats are counted: per machine gives each device one seat, per instance gives each running copy of the app its own seat.

perMachine.hint: One seat per machine, for all app instances on it.

perInstance.hint: One seat per running app instance, even on the same machine.

leaseDuration.label: Lease duration
leaseDuration.hint: How long a device keeps a seat between renewals.

allowedClockOffset.label: Allowed clock offset
allowedClockOffset.hint: Allowed clock drift between the server and client.

maxFileSize.label: Max file size
maxFileSize.hint: Size before a new log file starts.

maxBackups.label: Backups kept
maxBackups.hint: Old log files to keep, per product.

leaseDuration.hint: How long a device keeps a seat between renewals.

meterAttributes.title: Meter attributes
meterAttributes.hint: Usage limits on this license and current usage.

licenseMetadata.title: License metadata
licenseMetadata.hint: Extra details added to this license.

productMetadata.title: Product metadata
productMetadata.hint: Extra details added to this product.

notActivated.title: Activate a License for This Product
notActivated.description: No license is activated for this product yet. Until you activate one, devices can't get a seat from the license server.

gracePeriodOver.title: The License Server Needs to Sync
gracePeriodOver.description: The license server hasn't synced over the internet for longer than this license allows, so devices can't get a seat. Connect it to the internet and select Sync.

expired.title: This Product's License Has Expired
expired.description: The license for this product has expired, so devices can't get a seat from the license server. Ask your software vendor to renew the license. Then select Sync, or activate again if the server has no internet access.

suspended.title: This Product's License Is Suspended
suspended.description: The license for this product is suspended, so devices can't get a seat from the license server. Contact your software vendor.

disabled.title: This Product Is Disabled
disabled.description: The license server doesn't serve this product, so devices can't get a seat for it. To enable the product, edit {file} and restart the server.

activateDialog.title: Activate {product}
activateDialog.description: Enter the license key you received for this product. This server needs internet access to reach {appName}.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate {product}?
deactivateDialog.description: This server stops handing out seats for this product, and devices using it lose their seats when their leases end. You can activate it again later with the same license key.
deactivateDialog.confirmLabel: Type the license key to confirm

error.outstandingOffline: Some devices still hold offline seats. Wait for their leases to end, or return them, before deactivating.
error.keyMismatch: This doesn't match the license key this product is activated with.

devicesPage.title: Devices
devicesPage.searchPlaceholder: Search by hostname and IP address

leaseType.hint: Online leases are renewed while the app runs. Offline leases let the device keep its seat without reaching this server until the lease expires.

leasedAt.hint: When this device got its seat.

leaseRenewedAt.hint: When the lease was last renewed.

leaseExpiresAt.hint: When the seat is freed if the lease isn't renewed.

settingsPage.banner: These settings come from the licensing server's config. To change them, edit the config and restart the server.

productDefaults.title: Product defaults
productDefaults.hint: Used unless a product or license overrides it.

offline.label: Offline
offline.hint: Yes: activated offline and not synced since.

offlineSeats.label: Offline seats
offlineSeats.hint: Seats that can be borrowed at once.

maxOfflineLeaseDuration.label: Max offline lease duration
maxOfflineLeaseDuration.hint: How long a seat can be borrowed.

tls.label: TLS
tls.hint: Not needed on a local network. For HTTPS, generate a self-signed certificate and add it to config.yml.
